title: American Folk Art Museum

services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: The Museum is fully accessible and offers tours to groups with special needs; additional lead time may be necessary to arrange these tours. Self-guided adult groups are encouraged to explore the Museum as individual visitors. There is no fee for self-guided groups. Reservations are required for groups of 5 or more, maximum 15 participants; please make your reservation at least 3-4 weeks prior to your visit. Led by experienced gallery guides and Museum educators, our facilitated exhibition tours at the Museum introduce groups to folk and self-taught art through discussion of themes and historical contexts of the art on view.
